release_definition.criterion: A verified Phase 1B set catalog with category-specific counts, set → card and card → set lookups, debut/reprint identification and English export support.

release_definition.criterion: Source-graded in-universe chronology, broad plane/character/faction history and difficult Q&A coverage reviewed for the documented knowledge-foundation scope, with explicit unresolved gaps.

blockers.what: The source-graded knowledge-foundation acceptance packet now exists with separate chronology ledgers, representative cited plane/character/faction/cross-plane evidence, explicit gaps and an expanding set of distinct difficult Q&A cases. Its deterministic rebuild and representative rules/Q&A tests must still pass on the exact candidate foundation-release commit; it does not establish exhaustive knowledge.

Cory has explicitly authorized automatic foundation-only acceptance once the documented engineering and exact-head CI gates genuinely pass. The authorization is recorded but not effective while those conditions are unmet; no second approval request is needed. An owner-reviewed deck is NOT required.
